topSignals.title: Priority stacks Elcogen and Topsoe remain quiet — status unchanged for a fourth consecutive day.
topSignals.text: Direct re-checks of both newsrooms today show no new item: Elcogen's latest post is still the Sept 21 Metrosert testing-cooperation announcement (15 days old; elcoStack E3000 G2 in volume production at the 360 MW ELCO I Tallinn factory), and Topsoe's press/financial-release pages still list the Aug 27 half-year results and Aug 31 Uniper e-methanol contract as the most recent dated items (36 days since any SOEC/SOFC-specific release). No stack/cell, capacity, or partnership news from either priority player in the window. Elcogen News, Topsoe News

topSignals.title: PJM's 6 GW data-center backstop procurement is now a full week unfiled.
topSignals.text: Seven days after FERC's Sept 29 suspension order, no refiling or new auction timeline has surfaced; the Feb 28, 2027 effective date (contingent on a successful resubmission) stands as the only dated marker. This remains the clearest near-term event where SOFC's relative competitiveness against gas turbines, batteries and demand-response in PJM territory would be tested. Utility Dive

topSignals.title: German policy calendar advances one notch: Netzpaket committee hearing is tomorrow (Oct 7); no confirmed outcome yet from the Oct 5 EEG-Novelle hearing.
topSignals.text: Searches today found no published readout of Monday's EEG-Novelle committee hearing (text/outcome not yet available), and the Bundesrat committees' push to soften or delay the Redispatch-Vorbehalt clause (relevant to behind-the-meter/islanded generation, including SOFC) remains unresolved ahead of the Netzpaket hearing. Final Bundestag vote still targeted around Oct 16 (10 days out). Tagesspiegel Background

items.text: Elcogen (priority): Quiet — see Top Signal #1. Status unchanged: elcoStack E3000 G2 (75% electrical / 90% CHP efficiency, 650°C, 119-cell reversible stack) in volume production at ELCO I (360 MW/yr, Tallinn); ~€140M total funding (Baker Hughes, HD Hyundai, HydrogenOne Capital, Mirae, EU Innovation Fund).
Topsoe (priority): Quiet — see Top Signal #1. No SOEC/SOFC-specific item since the Aug 31 Uniper e-methanol FEED contract (not fuel-cell-specific) and the Aug 27 half-year results/outlook update.

Bloom Energy, FuelCell Energy, Ceres Power, Sunfire, SolydEra, Mitsubishi Power, Kyocera, Aisin, and new entrant Reverion (Germany, see Oct 5 digest for its €150M/$175M Series B): no new stack/cell-technology announcements found in the window.

Live — see Top Signals #2 and #3:* Germany's Netzpaket committee hearing is tomorrow (Oct 7); EEG-Novelle hearing outcome (Oct 5) not yet confirmed; final Bundestag vote still targeted around Oct 16. PJM's 6 GW backstop procurement remains unfiled, seven days after FERC's Sept 29 suspension order.

No change* in the last 24-48h on: Germany's KWK-Gesetz (CHP law) cabinet consideration (Oct 14); DOE/FERC large-load interconnection rulemaking (Apr 30, 2026 deadline); ITC 48E (30% fuel-cell credit) and 45V hydrogen credit; Virginia data-center electricity tax, New York permit moratorium, Texas development pause, EPA turbine NSPS; California's seven data-center bills signed Sept 21; Ireland's data-centre grid-connection rules — all as previously logged.
Bloom Energy (BE): No new operational or financial disclosures in the window. Q3 earnings now 21 days out, due Oct 27.

FuelCell Energy (FCEL): No new operational disclosures in the window; Nov 10, 2026 lead-plaintiff deadline (Fit Energy cost-overrun disclosure suit) still pending; backlog remains $3.6B per the Q3 transcript.
Ceres Power (CWR.L): No new market-moving disclosure since the Sept 30 "Total Voting Rights" RNS and Sept 23 interim results.
Reverion (private, Germany): No new financial news since the Sept 29-announced €150M/$175M Series B (see Oct 5 digest).

lcoe.text: No new independently-verified cost, capex/opex, or gas/H2/electricity price datapoint published in the last 24-48h beyond already-logged items (Reverion's unaudited 74.2% electrical-efficiency claim; Pan et al. $3.49/kg LCOH; Kourougianni et al. >30% annualized-cost reduction for rSOC+PV; Kim 2026 50–60% net electrical efficiency for commercial SOFC systems; Sept 25 EIA Henry Hub summer-2026 average of $2.93/MMBtu).

Pending calendar (updated): Germany's Netzpaket committee hearing Oct 7 (in 1 day); final EEG/Netzpaket Bundestag vote targeted Oct 16 (in 10 days); German KWK-Gesetz cabinet consideration Oct 14 (in 8 days); Bloom Q3 earnings Oct 27 (in 21 days); FCEL lead-plaintiff deadline Nov 10 (in 35 days); New Mexico air-quality permit deadline for Project Jupiter Nov 23 (in 48 days); PJM backstop resubmission timeline still TBD (new effective date, if refiled successfully, Feb 28, 2027).
